definitions.targeted interval for production: The subject entity aimed to extract resources from the specific interval specified by the object entity.
definitions.turned over to production on: The subject entity was transferred into active production status at the time specified by the object entity.
definitions.was previous producing interval for: The subject entity served as the prior productive zone or layer for the object entity.
definitions.watered out in: The subject entity lost its ability to produce economically due to water intrusion within the location specified by the object entity.
